meta.source: Meta Catalog search (28 models, 549 raw listings, 2026-11-06) + launch-day browser check for MacBook Pro 14 M6 only (see sources_note)
meta.sources_note: Meta Catalog raw files data/meta_catalog_raw_*_2026-11-06.json (gitignored). URLs cleaned of fbclid/utm/tracking params (variant-defining params kept). Stock not asserted by snapshot; delivered cost/tax not verified, no checkout started. Sale prices recorded at the sale price where the feed shows one (list price noted in the title). MacBook Pro 14 M6: the catalog round returned no qualifying row on launch day, so its 2 quotes (Apple $1,999, Best Buy $1,999, both in stock) come from the parent agent's launch-day browser check 2026-11-06, not the feed; the catalog.py pre-order note still says pre-order and is left untouched per the refresh limits (parent to update).
excluded_traps: Sale prices are recorded at the sale price (list noted in title): WF-1000XM5 Best Buy $248 (list $328), P.C. Richard $248 (list $329.95); Pixel Buds Pro 2 Best Buy $169 (list $229); MX Keys S Newegg $117 (list $140.49); Xbox ThinkEdu $61.99 (list $64.99), iBUYPOWER $49.99 (list $64.99); Superlight 2 Lenovo $159.99 (list $179.99).

Five models have ZERO qualifying rows in this round — read as a catalog-feed gap, not a delisting: Watch SE 3 (only carrier monthly/installment rows, a 44mm BJ's row, and wrong-color rows); MacBook Air 13 M5 (Apple rows carry other part numbers MDHG4LL/A/MDH74LL/A, campus-bookstore rows are education pricing); MacBook Air 15 M5 (only a Silver Best Buy row, wrong color); iPad A16 (only carrier $16.67/mo rows and accessories — the 10-31 $399 promos expired 10-31 23:59 ET); iPad Pro M5 11 (only 1TB/2TB/13-inch/cellular rows; the Staples $1,399 row is cellular ME2N4LL/A).

MacBook Pro 14 M6: catalog round returned no $1,999 base row (Apple $2,499 row is a higher config); quotes are from the launch-day browser check — see sources_note. M6 Pro UPC still unpublished; the 2026-11-07 10:00 PT UPC check cron stands.

MX Master 4 Graphite: still no US retailer Graphite row — Best Buy and Newegg rows this round are Pale Gray; Lenovo 'for Business, Brown Box - Graphite' excluded as a business edition; B&H checked separately (launch-day check) and does not list standard Graphite either. Only Logitech direct $119.99 stands.

Kindle: entry UNCHANGED (still pinned B0CFPL6CFY, user undecided). RC Willey $199.99 excluded although the price matches — its URL carries B0CFPJYX7P (the US code from the pending decision) and is left out to keep the pinning clean. Target Graphite $199.99 excluded (2026-release naming, different model year); Kohl's $149.99 excluded (base Kindle, not Paperwhite); Staples $199.99 included (description confirms Paperwhite 16GB Black). New low: NFM $196.99.

DualSense White: only Kohl's $74.99 qualifies this round. Best Buy, GameStop, Macy's, and PlayStation Direct rows from 10-31 are absent from the feed; Macy's $76.99 and shopcgx $64.99 rows state no color and are excluded; PlayStation Direct row this round is Starlight Blue.

WF-1000XM5 Black: street price down vs the single 10-31 Suncoast $299.99 quote — Best Buy $248 (sale), P.C. Richard $248 (sale, WF1000XM5-B in URL), FocusCamera $199.99. FocusCamera $199.99 is a >$5 move vs the prior quote and is flagged for a merchant-page recheck (no browser recheck in this run). B&H row is Silver (URL wf1000xm5_s), excluded.

MX Keys S: ThinkEdu's feed row is now Graphite 920-011406 ($138.99) — the prior Pale Grey 920-011559 ThinkEdu quote is gone from the feed. B&H 'for Mac (Pale Gray)' excluded (920-011622, different SKU). Staples $129.99 (920-011559 in title) and Lenovo Pale Grey $129.99 are new; Newegg Pale Grey $117 is a sale price.
Mac mini M6: B&H $899 (URL mhqk4ll_a, description 16GB/256GB) replaces Abt $899 at the same price. Clemson Tiger Tech Shop $799 excluded as education pricing (campus store).

AirPods Max 2: Best Buy $499 deal gone from the feed; Staples row this round is Blue (MHWM4AM/A, wrong color); B&H row is Starlight (MHWL4AM/A). Apple direct Midnight $549 and Sam's Club Midnight $549 are new.
iPad Air M4: Apple direct Space Gray $749 is new; B&H $699 deal gone from the feed; Quill rows this round are 256GB/wrong configs.
AirPods Pro 3: Apple $249, T-Mobile $249.99, AT&T $249.99 are new; Staples $249 from 10-31 is absent from the feed. Campus-store APU $249 excluded (education store).
Switch OLED White: Nintendo direct $399.99 and Target $399.99; Macy's $374.99 sale row states no color and is excluded; shopcgx $399.99 excluded (unverified seller).

Bose QC Ultra 2 Black: Bose direct $449, Macy's $459, and Target $462.47 rows state no color in the feed and are excluded; only Crutchfield Black $449 and T-Mobile Black $449.99 qualify. Prior NFM/Lenovo $369 quotes are absent from the feed.

WH-1000XM5 Black: Dell $399.99 and Macy's Black $398 qualify. Sony direct $349.99 excluded — feed color field reads 'midnight black' but the URL is a generic Sony article page, not a buyable product page.

Xbox Carbon Black: Best Buy Carbon Black $89.25 excluded as anomalous vs the $64.99 standard (Robot White $64.99 is the wrong color); BeachCamera 'with USB-C Cable' $64.99 excluded as a cable bundle; Target 2-pack excluded as a bundle.

Quest 3S: Best Buy $422.82 (Batman bundle) and Macy's $389.99 (Walking Dead bundle) excluded as bundles; CDW Business $407.99 excluded as a business edition. T-Mobile $349.99, QVC $349.00, NFM $349.99, Newegg $349.99 qualify at the same level as 10-31.

Non-US / wrong-variant rows excluded throughout (same rule as prior rounds): Ayoub (Lebanon) Anker A2688341 and Buds4 Pro SM-R640NZWA, iCuracao, syscom/ar-lb Lebanon rows, MEA/Latino suffixes, bundles, open-box/renewed/refurbished, no-seller marketplace rows, and accessories/cases/skins.
